description: Paniers Fraîcheur en gares d'Ile-de-France is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Dans les gares disposant du service, des maraîchers locaux vendent leurs produits une ou plusieurs fois par semaine à horaires fixes. Ces horaires sont fournis à titre d’information. La présence des maraîchers reste soumise à certains aléas tels qu’une variation saisonnière. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Gares, Services gare, Services voyageurs. Its keywords are Gare de voyageurs, Gares de voyageurs, Transilien, Île-de-France. The portal shows 2023-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is SNCF Open Data (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
